About me

More than bilingual support. A professional you can rely on.

Hi, I'm Shadia. I'm a Bilingual Virtual Assistant, Executive Assistant and Public Translator in English, based in Argentina and working remotely with professionals, entrepreneurs, agencies and businesses.

My background combines language expertise with administrative and executive support, allowing me to assist clients not only with what they need to communicate, but also with what they need to organize, coordinate and get done.

I'm organized, resourceful and detail-oriented, and I particularly enjoy becoming the person my clients can rely on to keep things running smoothly behind the scenes.
